title: 第255章 是你丫丫第256章 关山难越谁悲失路之人
slug: 凡人修仙我百世轮回成道祖

那是一张矛盾到极致的脸。
一双眼睛清澈如桃花源的山涧泉水，依旧是当年那个扎着羊角辫的小姑娘的模样。
灵动、干净，
盛满了跨越三千年时光都未曾褪色的依赖与孺慕。
可从额头到下颌，
从脖颈到手腕，
所有裸露的肌肤上，都覆盖着一层五彩斑斓的鳞甲……
不是单一的蛇鳞或鱼鳞，
而是混杂着蛇妖、鱼类、穿山甲……等无数妖族的鳞片纹路。
鳞甲在火光下泛着诡异的金属光泽，将那张本该明媚天真的脸庞，衬得半人半妖，触目惊心……
可即便如此，
陈默还是一眼就认出了她。
这是他第十一世，
在桃花源里收下的唯一弟子。
那个总跟在他身后，奶声奶气喊着“师父”的小丫丫。
那个会爬树摘最甜的桃花瓣给他泡茶，
会蹲在溪边看一下午游鱼，
会在他打坐时偷偷往他怀里塞野果的小姑娘。
一股难以言喻的心疼与苦涩，

如同潮水般瞬间淹没了陈默。
那时的丫丫，
天真烂漫，不染尘埃，是桃花源里最明媚的一抹光。
怎么会变成如今这副模样？
陈默怀里的孟章枯体“咚”地一声滑了半寸。
他见过太多生死，
十二世轮回里，
他亲手埋过战友，葬过亲人，早已学会了把悲伤压在心底，不动声色。
可这一刻，
他浑身的血液仿佛都冻住了，
喉咙被什么东西堵住，干哑，一个字都说不出来。
一道温柔的神识，
轻轻传入他的脑海，带着一丝小心翼翼的安抚：
“师父，别难过，丫丫我没事的！”

It was a face that was extremely contradictory.
Her eyes are as clear as the mountain spring water in the peach blossom garden, and she still looks like the little girl with pigtails.
Smart and clean,
It is full of dependence and admiration that has not faded across three thousand years.
From forehead to chin,
From neck to wrist,
All exposed skin is covered with a layer of colorful scales...
Not a single snake scale or fish scale,
Instead, it is mixed with the scale patterns of snake monsters, fish, pangolins... and countless other monsters.
The scales glowed with a strange metallic luster under the firelight, making the face that should have been bright and innocent look half-human and half-demon, which was shocking...
But even so,
Chen Mo still recognized her at a glance.
This is his eleventh life,
The only disciple accepted in the Peach Blossom Spring.
That little Yaya who was always following him, shouting "Master" in a sweet voice.
The one who can climb trees and pick the sweetest peach petals to make tea for him,
I would squat by the stream and watch fish swimming all afternoon.
The little girl who would secretly stuff wild fruits into his arms while he was meditating.
An indescribable feeling of heartache and bitterness,
Like a tide, Chen Mo was instantly flooded.
Yaya at that time,
Innocent and innocent, unstained by dust, it is the brightest light in the Peach Blossom Spring.
How did it become like this?
Meng Zhang's body in Chen Mo's arms slipped half an inch with a thud.
He has seen too many lives and deaths,
In twelve reincarnations,
He had personally buried his comrades and relatives, and had long since learned to suppress his grief deep in his heart and remain calm.
But at this moment,
The blood all over his body seemed to be frozen,
My throat was blocked by something, making me dumb and unable to speak a word.
A gentle consciousness,
Passed gently into his mind, with a hint of careful comfort:
"Master, don't be sad, Yaya, I'm fine!"
